messages.author: 4511ff9c48f53769
messages.subject: SEM not converging
parts:
Hi everyone,

I am fairly new to lavaan and am trying to run the following path analysis:

sem.model = "
newalzd ~ wm + ltm + vf + wm.decline + ltm.decline + vf.decline + DIABETES + apoe1 + apoe2 + SEX + race.black + race.indian + race.pacific + race.asian + EDUC + NACCAGEB + CVAFIB + CVHATT + CVCHF + HYPERTEN + HYPERCHO + SMOKYRS + THYROID + ALCOHOL + B12DEF
wm ~ DIABETES + apoe1 + apoe2 + SEX + race.black + race.indian + race.pacific + race.asian + EDUC + NACCAGEB + CVAFIB + CVHATT + CVCHF + HYPERTEN + HYPERCHO + SMOKYRS + THYROID + ALCOHOL + B12DEF
ltm ~ DIABETES + apoe1 + apoe2 + SEX + race.black + race.indian + race.pacific + race.asian + EDUC + NACCAGEB + CVAFIB + CVHATT + CVCHF + HYPERTEN + HYPERCHO + SMOKYRS + THYROID + ALCOHOL + B12DEF
vf ~ DIABETES + apoe1 + apoe2 + SEX + race.black + race.indian + race.pacific + race.asian + EDUC + NACCAGEB + CVAFIB + CVHATT + CVCHF + HYPERTEN + HYPERCHO + SMOKYRS + THYROID + ALCOHOL + B12DEF
wm.decline ~ wm + DIABETES + apoe1 + apoe2 + SEX + race.black + race.indian + race.pacific + race.asian + EDUC + NACCAGEB + CVAFIB + CVHATT + CVCHF + HYPERTEN + HYPERCHO + SMOKYRS + THYROID + ALCOHOL + B12DEF 
ltm.decline ~ ltm + DIABETES + apoe1 + apoe2 + SEX + race.black + race.indian + race.pacific + race.asian + EDUC + NACCAGEB + CVAFIB + CVHATT + CVCHF + HYPERTEN + HYPERCHO + SMOKYRS + THYROID + ALCOHOL + B12DEF
vf.decline ~ vf + DIABETES + apoe1 + apoe2 + SEX + race.black + race.indian + race.pacific + race.asian + EDUC + NACCAGEB + CVAFIB + CVHATT + CVCHF + HYPERTEN + HYPERCHO + SMOKYRS + THYROID + ALCOHOL + B12DEF

newalzd ~ 1
wm ~ 1
ltm ~ 1
vf ~ 1
wm.decline ~ 1
ltm.decline ~ 1
vf.decline ~ 1

newalzd ~~ newalzd
wm ~~ wm
ltm ~~ ltm
vf ~~ vf
wm.decline ~~ wm.decline
ltm.decline ~~ ltm.decline
vf.decline ~~ vf.decline

newalzd ~~ 0*wm + 0*ltm + 0*vf + 0*wm.decline + 0*ltm.decline + 0*vf.decline
wm ~~ 0*ltm + 0*vf + 0*wm.decline + 0*ltm.decline + 0*vf.decline
ltm ~~ 0*vf + 0*wm.decline + 0*ltm.decline + 0*vf.decline
vf ~~ 0*wm.decline + 0*ltm.decline + 0*vf.decline
wm.decline ~~ 0*ltm.decline + 0*vf.decline
ltm.decline ~~ 0*vf.decline
"

Race and apoe are unordered factors with more than two levels so I dummy coded them to have K-1 columns. "newalzd" is the only categorical endogenous variable so I have ordered it in the sem argument: 

sem.fit <- sem(sem.model, data = naccdata.sem, estimator = "WLSMV", std.ov = FALSE, std.lv = FALSE, ordered = c("newalzd"))

Even after dealing with the categorical variables however, my model still does not converge, giving the following warnings:

Warning messages:
1: In muthen1984(Data = X[[g]], ov.names = ov.names[[g]], ov.types = ov.types,  :
  lavaan WARNING: trouble inverting W matrix; used generalized inverse
2: In lavaan::lavaan(model = sem.model, data = naccdata.sem, std.lv = FALSE,  :
  lavaan WARNING: model has NOT converged!

The problem does not seem to be underidentification since the model passes the t rule. So what is the issue? My sample size is 3,851. Is that too small for this model?

Thank you very much for your help.

Kaushik

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: SEM not converging
parts: "newalzd" is the only categorical endogenous variable so I have ordered it in the sem argument:
Does your model converge if you remove this one outcome from the model?
The problem does not seem to be underidentification since the model passes the t rule. So what is the issue? My sample size is 3,851. Is that too small for this model?

Don't know, but you could try lowering the number of estimates by setting fixed.x = TRUE and maybe also conditional.x = TRUE.  No idea whether that will work since I don't know what the problem with the weight matrix is.  There might be some linear dependency among your variables...
